# Absence needs a baseline

`customer_support.mm.churn_signal_detection.absence_needs_a_baseline` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> Absence is a signal, but only against a stored expectation.

Nothing arrives when a customer goes quiet, so there is no event for a rule to match on. Detection requires a remembered picture of that account's normal behaviour, which makes this a baseline capability rather than an event capability and explains why it degrades badly on new accounts.
